subject: Extracting elements of z matrix in community model

messages.author: 63545f60f79347ce
messages.subject: Extracting elements of z matrix in community model
parts:
The mcmc.list object that is created after JAGS processes a community model's text file does not appear to contain columns for each element of the z matrix.

Is there a way to specify that elements of the z matrix should be included in the mcmc.list object?

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Extracting elements of z matrix in community model
parts:
Yes, you can simply add "z" to the vector of monitored parameters.
To return the entire z matrix, do this:
mod.jags <- communityModel(...)
mod.jags@params <- c(mod.jags@params, "z")
fit(...)

Please also see this thread for more details:
https://groups.google.com/g/camtrapr/c/JnfNoowrF_U/m/gmE4xsbXCAAJ
